lines.t: (Verse 1)
I feel the weight, it’s in my chest
I try to fight, I try my best
But every step just pulls me back
Into the echo, into the cracks
I hear the silence pushing in
Like a shadow under my skin
But now a light is coming back,
And I want it to kindle again.
(Pre-Chorus)
I’ve felt lost, so find me.
Light a flame and burn away the dross that binds me.
(Chorus)
Burn in me again, let Your light enter back in
Take what was broken, make it whole again
I won’t run, I won’t hide, I won’t break under the pain
Burn in me again, burn in me again
Light a flame in my soul, make it burn bright
Set it deep in my bones, set it right
I was lost, now I know where I stand
Burn in me again, burn in me again
(Verse 2)
The noise fades out, I start to breathe
Something steady underneath
Not as loud, but still it stays
Like a glow that won’t decay
I don’t need to understand
I just need to feel Your hand
(Pre-Chorus)
I wandered far, but You stayed even then.
So light a flame in me again.
(Chorus)
Burn in me again, let Your light enter back in
Take what was broken, make it whole again
I won’t run, I won’t hide, I won’t break under the pain
Burn in me again, burn in me again
Light a flame in my soul, make it burn bright
Every scar, every fight in the night
You are here, You remain, You sustain
Burn in me again, burn in me again
(Bridge)
Break me down, build me up
Turn the dust pure
Break me down, build me up
Every crack, every cut
Break me down, build me up
Fill my cup
(Final Chorus)
Burn in me again, let Your light enter back in
Take what was broken, make it whole again
I am Yours, I am Yours, I am Yours till the end
Burn in me again, burn in me again
Light a flame in my soul, make it burn bright
No more fear, no more chains in the night
You are all that I need, You remain
Burn in me again, burn in me again
